data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'gladys' meaning 'maiden, young girl, joy, gladness'. In Christianity, Gladine represents joy and gladness, often associated with the Virgin Mary. The name Gladine carries the meaning “Joyful, glad” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gladine usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful, glad and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of joy and gladness in one's spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Gladine belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joyful, glad.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gladine total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
data.cultural_impact: In Western culture, the name Gladine may carry associations with joy, happiness, and charming qualities often attributed to a young maiden or girl.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Christian faith, the name Gladine may carry a deeper spiritual significance rooted in the joy and gladness experienced during the birth and adoration of Jesus Christ. This signifies the immense joy and peace present in the birth and life of the Savior. Gladine may also serve as a reminder of the unending joy and happiness that comes with living a life surrendered to God. It reflects the hope, peace, and joy found in the love and grace of God. Traditionally, the name may be associated with the Virgin Mary, who embodied these qualities in raising and nurturing the Son of God.
